Owner-manager resistance is the single strongest predictor of failed AI adoption in fashion SMEs

risk_register.label: Vendor dependency risk
risk_register.mitigation: Aspiga will conduct a thorough review of their marketing automation tools, particularly Klaviyo, to ensure they are properly integrated and configured on their Shopify platform, reducing their reliance on a single vendor.
risk_register.regulatory_ref: Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 — data portability provisions
fashion_extensions_applied: Shopify platform dependency — significant portions of Agent 2 recommendations assume Shopify, creating risk if the business migrates platforms

risk_register.label: AI accuracy and hallucination risk
risk_register.mitigation: Aspiga will implement a human review process for AI-generated content, such as product recommendations, to ensure accuracy and reduce the risk of AI hallucinations on their Shopify platform.
risk_register.regulatory_ref: UK AI Bill 2026 — accuracy and transparency obligations
fashion_extensions_applied: AI-generated size advice that is wrong drives returns rather than reducing them — directly counterproductive to the primary use case
AI-generated product descriptions containing incorrect material composition create trading standards liability

risk_register.label: Ethical and bias risk
risk_register.mitigation: Aspiga will review and update their privacy policy to explicitly mention the use of AI and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, leveraging their existing Cookiebot integration on their Shopify platform.
risk_register.regulatory_ref: UK Equality Act 2010 — protected characteristics in automated decision-making
fashion_extensions_applied: Sizing bias — AI sizing recommendations trained primarily on standard UK size data may underserve plus-size, petite or non-standard body types who represent a majority of real customers
Fast-fashion sustainability — AI demand forecasting optimised purely for sell-through rate may conflict with the business's sustainability commitments or consumer expectations around overconsumption

deliverables.name: configuration_guide_judge.me
deliverables.content: To configure Judge.me for Aspiga's Shopify store, navigate to the Judge.me app in the Shopify app store, click 'Get' to install, and then follow the setup wizard to connect your store and configure the automated review collection sequence. market_tools_recommended.why_this_business: Aspiga's moderate budget and Shopify store make Judge.me an ideal choice for its lightweight and budget-friendly review collection app.
Trustpilot's independent review platform and recognisability to UK shoppers make it a strong contender for Aspiga's return reduction goals.

While Yotpo's full-featured reviews and loyalty platform is suitable for Aspiga's moderate budget, its medium setup complexity and lack of free tier may deter the business from investing time and resources.
